user_query: I'm hosting a company event and I need some icebreakers. Can you provide a random trivia fact and a playlist of popular songs? Also, check if there are any NBA games happening in our city and provide the details of the specific game.

TaskList.description: 获取一个随机的趣闻事实，用于破冰。
获取当前流行歌曲的播放列表。
查询所在城市是否有NBA比赛，并获取具体比赛的详细信息。
